test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is India's highest ranked City in Safest City category in the Mercer's 2019 Quality of Living Index?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chennai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai **has consistently been on **top of the safety index.**
 
• Mercer's 21st annual Quality of Living survey 2019 shows that in** 105th place.**
 
• It **ranks as** **Southern Asia's safest city. **
 
• It is safe to visit for everyone, irrespective of whether you are a backpacker or a solo female traveler. 
 
• Cities in Tamil Nadu, **Coimbatore, and Chennai**, are the safest for women to live in as they have the lowest rate of crimes against women.
 
• It stands out for its hospitality and is among the top cities in the world.
 
• Health tourists from across the world travel to Chennai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Quality of Living Index 2019** was released by the **Consulting Agency Mercer.**
 
• The index was based on the data analyzed between September and November 2018.
 
• **The index ranks 231 cities.**
 
• Austrian capital** Vienna** tops Mercer’s index of most liveable cities for the 10th year in a row.
 
• Hyderabad and Pune topped the list among the Indian cities with a rank of 143.
 
• **Bengaluru was the second best with a ranking of 149.**
 
• Mumbai with a ranking of 154 stood third among Indian cities.
 
• The capital of India,** New Delhi** ranked **162** on Mercer’s Quality Of Living Index.
